page.overview:
Who is Ashmanaille?

Ashmanaille is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is lanky with dark hair and brown eyes. She has a narrow face and a pointed nose. Her slender build makes her appear more tall than she really is.

She has a detached nature, seldom showing any emotion at all.

She thinks about clothes as much as anything else, and her clothes are always neat and of a high quality.
